tooltip.simplybows.bow.vine.ability: Plant a healing garden that restores allies and damages monsters. Your arrows can also heal allies directly.
tooltip.simplybows.bow.ice.ability: Fire a spread of frost arrows that home in on enemies.
tooltip.simplybows.bow.bubble.ability: Fire arrows that travel freely through water and create bubble columns on impact.
tooltip.simplybows.bow.bee.ability: Fire bees at enemies. Fully drawn shots poison their target.
tooltip.simplybows.bow.blossom.ability: Create a petal storm that follows enemies and leaps between targets.
tooltip.simplybows.bow.earth.ability: Erupt a field of dripstone spikes that damages enemies and knocks them upward.

tooltip.simplybows.bow.vine.rune.pain: Plant a patch of cursed wither roses. Monsters inside take repeated magic damage. The patch does not heal allies.
tooltip.simplybows.bow.vine.rune.grace: Grow a healing cherry tree. It heals every ally in the patch and removes harmful effects.
tooltip.simplybows.bow.vine.rune.bounty: Grow three cherry trees that fire petal bolts at nearby monsters. Enemies in the area also receive Blindness and Nausea.
tooltip.simplybows.bow.vine.rune.chaos: Plant a spore blossom that drains and roots monsters. Players inside move faster.
tooltip.simplybows.bow.earth.rune.pain: Send a fissure of spikes along the shot direction. It damages enemies, briefly slows them, and knocks them upward.
tooltip.simplybows.bow.earth.rune.grace: Raise a solid dripstone wall. Nobody can walk or shoot through it, including you and your allies. Nearby allies gain Resistance and Slow Falling; a struck ally gains Absorption.
tooltip.simplybows.bow.earth.rune.bounty: Raise a filled eight-point star of dripstone. It expands outward and contracts inward three times, damaging enemies inside.
tooltip.simplybows.bow.earth.rune.chaos: Raise five pairs of jagged stone teeth. Each pair slams inward in turn, advancing away from you. Escape the next pair before it closes. A crushing hit roots you for 5 seconds.
tooltip.simplybows.bow.ice.rune.pain: Fire homing frost arrows that each seek a different enemy. String adds arrows. Hits cause a small frost splash and Slowness III for 5 seconds.
tooltip.simplybows.bow.ice.rune.grace: Fire a harmless arrow that seeks a nearby player. A swirling frost circle gives players and animals Resistance, Speed, and Regeneration.
tooltip.simplybows.bow.ice.rune.bounty: Fire a straight arrow that traps the struck enemy in a spiky ice prison. String extends the freeze from 3 seconds; Frame increases damage each second while trapped. Frost I slows them for 10 seconds from impact. They cannot move, attack, or use items while frozen.
tooltip.simplybows.bow.ice.rune.chaos: Raise a wall of ice where your arrow lands. It blocks movement and incoming projectiles.
tooltip.simplybows.bow.bee.rune.pain: Fire one homing bee. A successful hit attaches a stinging swarm that follows the enemy and repeatedly damages them.
tooltip.simplybows.bow.bee.rune.grace: Send bees to protect allies with Resistance. Each bee moves between allies who still need protection.
tooltip.simplybows.bow.bee.rune.bounty: Create a hive that sends out exploding bees. Their explosions damage and poison nearby enemies.
tooltip.simplybows.bow.bee.rune.chaos: Summon a honey storm. It slows enemies and attacks them with diving bees.
tooltip.simplybows.bow.bubble.rune.pain: Create a raincloud, even when you hit the ground. Falling water crystals splash nearby enemies, ignore armor, and briefly slow them.
tooltip.simplybows.bow.bubble.rune.grace: Create a shimmering water circle. Allies inside gain Resistance and Regeneration, and hostile shots are blocked.
tooltip.simplybows.bow.bubble.rune.bount: Create a bubble column filled with axolotls. The swarm repeatedly damages enemies inside.
tooltip.simplybows.bow.bubble.rune.chaos: Send a water wave forward that damages enemies and knocks them back.
tooltip.simplybows.bow.blossom.rune.pain: Create a ring of petals that repeatedly damages enemies inside.
tooltip.simplybows.bow.blossom.rune.grac: Create a swirling circle of petals and rising blossom motes. Allies inside gain Strength, increasing their melee damage.
tooltip.simplybows.bow.blossom.rune.boun: Grow a gathering blossom where your shot lands. Its spinning petals draw enemies together before releasing a burst at up to three nearby enemies.
tooltip.simplybows.bow.blossom.rune.chao: Summon koi that circle the impact area or struck target. They damage enemies and reflect incoming shots.

simplybows.config.upgrades.prefix: Enchanted String usually increases size, radius, duration, or count. Reinforced Frame usually increases damage or power. Shared formulas: size = 1 + stringLevel * Size Multiplier per String; damage = 1 + frameLevel * Damage Multiplier per Frame. Draw speed is ticks to a full draw; lower is faster.
simplybows.config.upgrades.maxLevelPerTy: Maximum Enchanted String level and maximum Reinforced Frame level on one bow.
simplybows.config.upgrades.maxTotalSlots: String levels plus Frame levels on one bow cannot exceed this. A rune does not use these slots.
simplybows.config.upgrades.sizeMultiplie: Size Multiplier per Enchanted String level
Enchanted String size formula: 1 + string level * this value. 0.2 means +20% size or radius per String level on bows that use the shared size multiplier.
simplybows.config.upgrades.damageMultipl: Damage Multiplier per Reinforced Frame level
Reinforced Frame damage formula: 1 + frame level * this value. 0.55 means +55% damage per Frame level on bows that use the shared damage multiplier.
simplybows.config.upgrades.drawSpeedEver: Ticks required to fully draw Everbloom. Lower is a faster draw.
simplybows.config.upgrades.drawSpeedWint: Ticks required to fully draw Winterfang. Lower is a faster draw.
simplybows.config.upgrades.drawSpeedBubb: Ticks required to fully draw Bubbleveil. Lower is a faster draw.
